operation_proposals.source_operation: ControlNet trainable encoder-copy branch with multi-scale feature extraction, zero-convolution projection, and block-wise injection into frozen U-Net feature maps
operation_proposals.why_no_existing_operation: The catalog can represent the documented learned feature mapping, zero-convolution projection, and additive injection as partial calls, but it has no operation representing the complete ControlNet encoder-copy architecture, multi-scale schedule, or exact receiving-port topology.

operation_proposals.source_operation: Transformer text encoding into semantic feature vectors
operation_proposals.why_no_existing_operation: The paper identifies a transformer-based text encoder but does not document its tokenization, lookup, layer schedule, pooling, or output projection sufficiently for decomposition into the existing primitives.

The paper documents timestep-conditioned U-Net denoising and iterative latent refinement, but the catalog does not represent the complete noise-prediction and reverse-diffusion update algebra or schedule.

operation_proposals.source_operation: VAE decoding from compact latent representation to high-resolution image
operation_proposals.why_no_existing_operation: The catalog has no VAE decoder operation, and the paper does not document the decoder's internal sequence of transformations.
